item.title: 6月12日のニュース：Trump Announces Iran Deal Signing This Weekend, but Tehran Denies Agreement
item.description:
Japan in English — 日本のニュースを英語で。今日のトップニュースを英語学習者向けにお届けします。
1. Trump Announces Iran Deal Signing This Weekend, but Tehran Denies Agreement 2. 19-Year-Old Ex-Boyfriend Arrested for Murder of 17-Year-Old Girl Found in Sagamihara Riverbed 3. Japan to Achieve 100% Non-Hormuz Oil Procurement Next Month, Supply Secured Until 2028 4. Second-in-Command of Illegal Scout Group 'Natural' Arrested in Osaka Pachinko Parlor 5. Emperor Holds Press Conference Before Netherlands-Belgium Visit, Expresses Hope for Public Understanding on Succession Debate 6. Japan National Team Support Video Displayed at Times Square Ahead of World Cup
